scripts.dev: node scripts/package-licenses.mjs public/third-party-licenses.txt && tsx watch src/server/index.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist/server', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.gate:sfu-admission: vitest run tests/room-route-controller.test.ts tests/hybrid-media-router.test.ts tests/sfu-resource-admission.test.ts tests/sfu-room-control.test.ts tests/livekit-token.test.ts tests/sfu-client.test.ts tests/route-transition.test.ts tests/server-config.test.ts tests/server-http.test.ts tests/server-signal.test.ts
scripts.gate:access-privacy: npm run build:client && vitest run tests/server-signal.test.ts && tsx scripts/access-privacy-gate.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
